indicator.title: Device turns orange or red
indicator.description: For the devices you follow ("Notify me" on a device's page), at most once per 30 minutes per device.

page.title: Devices
page.description: Everything in the house with a state: window contacts, thermostats, the dryer, smoke detectors, the alarm.

empty.title: No devices yet
empty.description: Add window contacts, thermostats and appliances to see the house at a glance.

noProfiles.title: Start with a profile
noProfiles.description: A profile says what a device reports (open/closed, temperature…) and which colour that gets on the plan. Pick a ready-made one.

noDevices.title: No devices yet
noDevices.description: Add your window contacts, thermostats and appliances, then place them on the floor plan.

form.description: Values and their sources are set on the device page; the position on the floor plan in the plan editor.
form.profileChangeHint: Changing the profile clears the device's current values.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The device, its values and its place on the plan are removed. The profile stays.

detail.valuesHint: Set values by hand, or connect them to Home Assistant below.
detail.valuesReadOnly: Values are kept up to date by the adults of the house.

values.invalid: This value doesn't fit the field.
values.fromHomeAssistant: This value comes from Home Assistant and can't be set by hand.

bindings.title: Value sources
bindings.description: Per field: set by hand, or read from a Home Assistant entity.
bindings.hint: Pick an entity with Browse, or type its id. After saving, the field takes the entity's current state and follows it live; linked values can't be set by hand.
bindings.invalid: Check the Home Assistant entity ids (e.g. binary_sensor.kitchen_window).

placement.allPlaced: Every device is on a plan.
placement.dragHint: Drag onto the plan, or use “Place on the plan” and tap a spot
placement.nudgeHint: Arrow keys move it (Shift: bigger steps).
placement.loadFailed: The devices couldn't be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

house.title: House
house.description: What's open, warm, running or armed, right now.

noFloors.title: No floor plan yet
noFloors.description: Add your floors and rooms first; devices are shown on their plans.

noDevicesHere.title: No devices on this floor
noDevicesHere.description: Drag devices onto the plan in the floor plan editor.

profiles.title: Device profiles
profiles.description: A profile is a type of device: the values it reports and the rules that colour it on the plan.

empty.title: No profiles yet
empty.description: Add one of the presets below and adjust it, or start from scratch.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The profile is removed. This can't be undone.
delete.inUse: Devices use this profile. Move them to another profile first.

presets.title: Ready-made profiles
presets.description: Adding one creates your own copy that you can change freely.

editor.newDescription: Define the fields first, then the rules that colour the indicator.
editor.staleHint: Home Assistant values older than this show as "No recent data". Manual values never go stale.
editor.fallbackHint: Used when no rule matches, or when the value is unknown or stale.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: What the device reports. The primary field is shown next to the indicator on the plan.
fields.label: Label

rules.title: Indicator rules
rules.description: Checked from top to bottom; the first rule that matches decides the colour, label and icon.
rules.empty: No rules yet: the indicator always uses the colour below.
rules.label: Label

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Try sample values to see the indicator.

live.offlineHint: No live connection. Values may be out of date; it reconnects by itself.
